scope: Independent static read-only audit of six prepared finalization helpers; no execution, live acceptance, or original-main mutation.
checks: All six helpers independently read in full and syntax parsed without importing or executing their top-level bodies. Their only differences from round113 are the expected round/worktree/base and preservation bindings.

Observer derives topic/tree/PR from mutually consistent successful receipts and actual merged PR, verifies single-parent merge and queue trees, then observes the five exact workflow/event/head combinations. It reports observation separately from acceptance.

Collector acquires paginated run lists, exact latest attempt/jobs/checks/annotations and rechecks run stability. Full REST discussions plus GraphQL thread/comment pagination and configured issue comments/events remain retained. A successful acquisition alone is not semantic acceptance.

Job logs are acquired for exact successful attempt/job identities under hosted-final/job-logs and latest runs rechecked; maintenance issue456 with comments/events is retained. Inventory is explicitly inspection-only; diagnostic string scans do not replace manual semantic reading.

Finalizer requires explicit positive independent semantic assessment bound to actual acquisition plus three hashed evidence sections, successful exact postmerge clone commands/coverage/log/config/helper digests, cleanup and exact topic/base/tree/merge. Checks precede original-main mutations.

Original main must be clean at the expected base, preserve every baseline byte/mode/symlink, avoid newly tracked collisions, fast-forward only with no overwrite of ignored paths, then recheck preservation/ref deletion and the retained review-base tag.

Archive uses13599 measured baseline entries, an ignored nonexisting destination and matching merged main. It copies current-round top-level evidence and recursively retained release/hosted raw evidence with exact digest verification. Raw scientific source roots remain separate as disclosed.
limits: Future commit/push/config/hosted/preflight/postmerge/cleanup inputs did not yet exist and are not accepted by this audit.
Receipt consumers rely on the separately reviewed producers and must bind actual final bytes at execution; manual raw hosted semantic review remains required.
No exhaustive pure-function test suite rerun was warranted for substitution-only adaptation.
